paragraphs: Port Vision is an AI-driven application created to automate the analysis of network switches through images. By leveraging computer vision, this tool detects which ports are in use, identifies cable connections, and associates connected cables with the correct port numbers on network switches. Additionally, Port Vision can optionally monitor link activity by analyzing uplink indicator lights, providing insights into whether a connection is active.
features: Port Detection: Automatically detects LAN ports, cable connections, and port stack groups in network switches.
Connection Status: Identifies if a port is connected or empty.
Real-time Inference: Provides instant feedback through an interactive interface, ideal for quick on-site network assessments.
